title: Maintaining Proper Trap Arm Alignment
description: A P-trap relies on a standing liquid seal to block hazardous sewer gases from entering living spaces. However, if the trap arm drops below the level of the trap weir before reaching its vent pipe connection, it creates an unvented S-trap action. This geometric flaw allows discharging water to siphon the trap completely dry. Professional installers verify that the trap arm maintains a proper slope and stays above the trap weir line, preserving the essential water barrier.

This geometric flaw allows discharging water to siphon the trap completely dry. Professional installers verify that the trap arm maintains a proper slope and stays above the trap weir line, preserving the essential water barrier.
